verdict.rationale: Zep is a context and memory platform, and a SaaS platform of this kind could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented way for users to set up autonomous or scheduled automations. Zep-managed background processing, such as incrementally updated thread summaries and graph ingestion on add_messages, is adjacent internal behavior, not user-defined automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
